statement_en: Let $z_1,\ldots,z_n\in \mathbb{C}$ with $z_1=1$. Must there exist an absolute constant $c>0$ such that\[\max_{1\leq k\leq n}\left\lvert \sum_{i}z_i^k\right\rvert>c?\]
statement_lean:
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def powerSum {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, z i ^ k

theorem erdos_31695 :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin n → ℂ),
        z ⟨0, hn⟩ = 1 →
          ∃ k : Fin n, c < ‖powerSum z (k.val + 1)‖ := by
  sorry
